q1_2025_guidance_sales_yoy_growth_low_pc.description: Extract the low end of expected Q1 2025 net sales growth versus first quarter 2024, as a percentage number (for example, 5% becomes 5) from the 'First Quarter 2025 Guidance' section.

q1_2025_guidance_fx_impact_usd.description: Extract the expected foreign exchange impact on Q1 2025 net sales from the 'First Quarter 2025 Guidance' section. Convert billions to USD millions (for example, $151.0 billion becomes 151000). Return an unfavorable impact as a negative number.

q1_2024_operating_income_guidance_compar.description: Extract the first quarter 2024 operating income that the Q1 2025 operating income guidance is compared with ('compared with $X billion in first quarter 2024') from the 'First Quarter 2025 Guidance' section. Convert billions to USD millions (for example, $151.0 billion becomes 151000).

q1_2024_leap_year_net_sales_impact.description: Extract the approximate net sales that Leap Year added in first quarter 2024 from the 'First Quarter 2025 Guidance' section. Convert billions to USD millions (for example, $151.0 billion becomes 151000).

q1_2025_guidance_assumptions.description: Extract the stated assumptions behind the guidance from the 'First Quarter 2025 Guidance' section. Return the wording as written.

q1_2025_guidance_margin_commentary.description: Extract any explicit management commentary on expected margin changes for future periods. Return null if the document has none.

fy2025_expected_capital_investment_comme.description: Extract any explicit commentary on expected 2025 capital expenditures or capital investment levels. Return null if the document has none.

topic.description: Short name of the partnership, contract, launch or development.

details.description: One factual sentence describing it, as stated in the document.

value.description: Any number stated with it (for example a dollar amount or count). Null if none.

unit.description: Unit of the value (for example 'USD millions', 'models'). Null if none.

period.description: Period the item relates to, if stated. Null if none.

strategic_partnerships_and_investments.description: List notable strategic partnerships, collaborations, customer agreements and contract wins named in the release's highlights.

topic.description: Short name of the partnership, contract, launch or development.

details.description: One factual sentence describing it, as stated in the document.

value.description: Any number stated with it (for example a dollar amount or count). Null if none.

unit.description: Unit of the value (for example 'USD millions', 'models'). Null if none.

period.description: Period the item relates to, if stated. Null if none.

other_material_business_developments.description: List other material business developments named in the release's highlights: product launches, new services, regional expansions and relief efforts.

metric.description: Metric name exactly as labeled in the document. For rows under a segment heading in the Supplemental tables, prefix the segment, for example 'AWS Segment: — Net sales'.

details.description: Short description including the table or section the metric comes from.

value.description: Numeric value. Percentages as numbers (36% becomes 36). Values in parentheses as negative numbers.

period.description: Period, for example 'Q4 2024' for quarterly columns, 'TTM as of Q4 2024' for trailing-twelve-month rows, or the period stated in the text.

operating_metrics_and_kpis.description: Extract every operating metric and KPI: each row and quarter column (Q3 2023 through Q4 2024) of the Supplemental Financial Information and Business Metrics tables as a separate record, plus quantified highlights in the release text (delivery speed, viewers, device sales, event attendance). Skip N/A cells.
